preconditions.description: Input constraints: N and M are lengths of strings S and T (1 to 200), K is the total allowed transformation cost (0 to 500).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: Strings S and T contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer representing the maximal number of occurrences of S as a substring in T' after transformations with total cost ≤ K.

postconditions.expression: def cyclic_distance(c1, c2): return min(abs(ord(c1) - ord(c2)), 26 - abs(ord(c1) - ord(c2)))
postconditions.description: Helper function to compute the minimal cyclic distance between two lowercase letters.
Helper function to check if the total transformation cost from T to T' is ≤ K.

postconditions.expression:
def count_substring_occurrences(S, T_prime):
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(T_prime) - len(S) + 1) if T_prime[i:i+len(S)] == S)
postconditions.description: Helper function to count the number of occurrences of S as a substring in T'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(count_substring_occurrences(S, T_prime) for T_prime in possible_transformations(T, K)))
postconditions.description: Output is the maximum number of S occurrences in any valid T' derived from T with total transformation cost ≤ K.
